title: The Missing Log File
story: The web server is failing, and the monitoring dashboard has chosen this moment to become an abstract art installation.
objective: Find every file ending in .log inside /var/app that contains the word ERROR. Your command output must identify only the matching log files.
hints: grep searches inside files; its -l flag prints only matching filenames.
explanation: find selects filesystem entries, while grep tests file contents. Combining small, focused tools is a core Unix pattern; recursive grep is another valid route.
